notes.title: Steam Flyers Teaser Trailer Released
notes.content:
We've released our first teaser trailer for our upcoming game "Steam Flyers" a Steampunk themed air combat game. Follow us on facebook and twitter for more development updates!

Teaser Trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fiZe-qeaHJY

Take to the skies and engage in dogfights! Weave in and out of airship fleets as they battle against each other, in a Steampunk fantasy world. Steam Flyers brings to life future predictions of warfare from a 19th century perspective. Participate in bombing runs against enormous zeppelin battleships. Strafe ground units that have one wheeled tanks and steam powered trebuchets. Escort airship fleets from jet powered biplanes…… Then, return back to base and land on your Aircraft Carrier Steam Train. 

Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/Steam-Flyers-1456058104695442/timeline/
Twitter
https://www.facebook.com/Steam-Flyers-1456058104695442/timeline/

Thanks
Luke

notes.title: Sound Effects and Explosions Reworked
notes.content:
We have reworked all of the sound effects and improved all of the explosions in the game.  This should give a quality boost to the gameplay experience. Enemy ships have also been added to level 2, making that level feel more engaging. 


* Sound effects for jet fighters and spaceships added
* Ship destroying sound effect and explosions added
* Explosions and sound effects added for buildings
* Better sound effects for laser weapons and cannons
* Missile sound effects Improved
* Anti aircraft sound effects Improved
* Proximity missile lock on radius lowered
* Health regeneration goes 0.2 seconds faster
* Level 4 - Difficulty lowered and tweaked
* Level 4 - More sound effects added to bombers 
* Level 2 - Enemy ships added
* Level 2 - More ally fighters added
* Various more sound effects tweaks

Let us know what you think. The game continues to be updated and improved.  Thanks for playing the game!

notes.title: Joystick Support Added
notes.content:
It is now possible to play the game with a joystick. However, this is a limited feature and has been designed around the Logitech Extreme 3D pro. So the game is best played with that joystick or similar devices.

Also there has been a bug fixed that made the mouse input very sluggish. You no longer have to turn up the mouse sensitivity settings in the options menu in order to try and get reasonable manuverability. If you have the mouse sensitivity settings turned up very high, it might be a good idea to turn down the values back to 1 now that the bug is fixed.
